The '''CY-M ink rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] looted one, after destroying the [[CY-M Prototype]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CY-M ink rifle appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
